routes.description: Line 402 today — the bay-mouth crossing straight under the Terceira Ponte, Convento da Penha and Morro do Moreno overhead: the network's signature visual. Haversine 0.59 nm + small alignment margin.

Line 401's through-run: the full length of the Baía de Vitória past the Cinco Pontes, Porto de Vitória cranes and the old-town waterfront. Haversine 3.97 nm + ~25% coastal-wrap margin for the winding bay channel around Ilha do Príncipe.

The mangrove gastronomy run — up the bay and into the Santa Maria river mouth to the moqueca restaurant row; already a scheduled stop on commercial bay tours. Haversine 3.34 nm + ~45% wrap for the channel around the island's west shore and mangrove approaches.
Line 401 first leg down the northwest channel, Cariacica to the Ilha do Príncipe intercity bus terminal. Haversine 1.08 nm + channel-alignment margin.
Line 401 second leg (added May 2026): bus terminal to the capital's waterfront past the port front. Haversine 3.27 nm + ~25% wrap for the channel bend around Ilha do Príncipe and the port.
Line 403 today — Cariacica direct to Vila Velha, the longest scheduled run, exiting the bay channel to the mouth. Haversine 4.24 nm + ~25% wrap for the winding channel.
The tour operators' existing boarding pair (Capitão Grilo) across the bay mouth — a premium-leisure mirror of the 402 transit crossing. Haversine 0.71 nm + margin.
Intercity-arrival spur to the mangrove gastronomy waterfront via the northwest channels. Haversine 2.88 nm + ~50% wrap for the mangrove channel routing.
Station-to-urban-beach hop around the Enseada do Suá headland to the kiosk strip. Haversine 0.63 nm + headland margin.

Business-district connector: aquaviário hub to the yacht club at Praia do Canto, wrapping the Enseada do Suá headland and threading between Ilha do Frade and the mainland. Haversine 1.22 nm + ~35% coastal-wrap margin.
Marina-to-marina leg along the Canal da Passagem between Praia do Canto and Santa Luíza. Haversine 0.71 nm + ~40% wrap for the canal's dogleg.
Short premium spur from the yacht club across to the private residential island's waterfront. Haversine 0.43 nm + margin.
Cross-mouth beach hop from historic Vila Velha to Ilha do Boi's sheltered beaches, passing under the Terceira Ponte approach. Haversine 1.09 nm + wrap margin around the bay-mouth point.
